content.text: Here, the operator picks up two parts to assemble a new piece.

Could you identify the parts that was picked up in the previous images? Choices:  A. The part in green circle and the part in cyan circle. B. The part in yellow circle and the part in green circle. C. The part in green circle and the part in blue circle. D. The part in blue circle and the part in yellow circle. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
